events.summary: Hey everyone! Our demo is live for SteamNext fest! events.title: 🎛️ Dev Diary: Back in Action on 10 Second Mix Tape! 🎶
events.summary: Sup playas! We're excited to share that we're back on the development of 10 Second Mix Tape — our online collaborative music game where players create tiny tracks together in real time across the internet. It’s chaotic, creative, and all about expressing yourself through sound in just 10 seconds. Our top priority right now is strengthening the core experience: making music.
